name: Table
description: Represents a single table. The Table object is a member of the Tables collection. The Tables collection includes all the tables in the specified selection, range, or document.
remarks: Use Tables (Index), where Index is the index number, to return a single Table object. The index number represents the position of the table in the selection, range, or document. The following example converts the first table in the active document to text. Use the Add method to add a table at the specified range. The following example adds a 3x4 table at the beginning of the active document.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: Returns a Range object that represents the portion of a document that is contained within the specified table.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Table object.

properties.name: Columns
properties.description: Returns a Columns collection that represents all the table columns in the table. Read-only.

properties.name: Rows
properties.description: Returns a Rows collection that represents all the table rows within a table. Read-only.

properties.name: Borders
properties.description: Returns a Borders collection that represents all the borders for the specified object.

properties.name: Shading
properties.description: Returns a Shading object that refers to the shading formatting for the specified object.

properties.name: Uniform
properties.description: True if all the rows in a table have the same number of columns. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: AutoFormatType
properties.description: Returns the type of automatic formatting that's been applied to the specified table. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Tables
properties.description: Returns a Tables collection that represents all the tables nested within the specified table. Read-only.

properties.name: NestingLevel
properties.description: Returns the nesting level of the specified table. Read-only Long.

properties.name: AllowAutoFit
properties.description: Allows Microsoft Word to automatically resize cells in a table to fit their contents. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: PreferredWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the preferred width (in points or as a percentage of the window width) for the specified table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: PreferredWidthType
properties.description: Returns or sets the preferred unit of measurement to use for the width of the specified table. Read/write WdPreferredWidthType.

properties.name: TopPadding
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to add above the contents of all the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: BottomPadding
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to add below the contents of a single cell or all the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: LeftPadding
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to add to the left of the contents of all the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: RightPadding
properties.description: Returns or sets the amount of space (in points) to add to the right of the contents of all the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: Spacing
properties.description: Returns or sets the spacing (in points) between the cells in a table. Read/write Single.

properties.name: TableDirection
properties.description: Returns or sets the direction in which Microsoft Word orders cells in the specified table. Read/write WdTableDirection.

properties.name: ID
properties.description: Returns or sets the identifying label for the specified table when the document is saved as a webpage. Read/write String.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns or sets the style for the specified table. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: ApplyStyleHeadingRows
properties.description: True for Microsoft Word to apply heading-row formatting to the first row of the selected table. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ApplyStyleLastRow
properties.description: True for Microsoft Word to apply last-row formatting to the last row of the specified table. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ApplyStyleFirstColumn
properties.description: True for Microsoft Word to apply first-column formatting to the first column of the specified table. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ApplyStyleLastColumn
properties.description: True for Microsoft Word to apply last-column formatting to the last column of the specified table. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ApplyStyleRowBands
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to apply style bands to the rows in a table if an applied preset table style provides style banding for rows. Read/write.

properties.name: ApplyStyleColumnBands
properties.description: Returns or sets a Boolean that represents whether to apply style bands to the columns in a table if an applied preset table style provides style banding for columns. Read/write.

properties.name: Title
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that contains a title for the specified table. Read/write.

properties.name: Descr
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that contains a description for the specified table. Read/write.

methods.name: SortAscending
methods.description: Sorts paragraphs or table rows in ascending alphanumeric order.

methods.name: SortDescending
methods.description: Sorts table rows in descending alphanumeric order.

methods.name: AutoFormat
methods.signature: AutoFormat([Format As Variant], [ApplyBorders As Variant], [ApplyShading As Variant], [ApplyFont As Variant], [ApplyColor As Variant], [ApplyHeadingRows As Variant], [ApplyLastRow As Variant], [ApplyFirstColumn As Variant], [ApplyLastColumn As Variant], [AutoFit As Variant])
methods.description: Applies a predefined look to a table.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: The format to apply. This parameter can be a WdTableFormat constant, a WdTableFormatApply constant, or a TableStyle object.

parameters.name: ApplyBorders
parameters.description: True to apply the border properties of the specified format. The default value is True.

parameters.name: ApplyShading
parameters.description: True to apply the shading properties of the specified format. The default value is True.

parameters.name: ApplyFont
parameters.description: True to apply the font properties of the specified format. The default value is True.

parameters.name: ApplyColor
parameters.description: True to apply the color properties of the specified format. The default value is True.

parameters.name: ApplyHeadingRows
parameters.description: True to apply the heading-row properties of the specified format. The default value is True.

parameters.name: ApplyLastRow
parameters.description: True to apply the last-row properties of the specified format. The default value is False.

parameters.name: ApplyFirstColumn
parameters.description: True to apply the first-column properties of the specified format. The default value is True.

parameters.name: ApplyLastColumn
parameters.description: True to apply the last-column properties of the specified format. The default value is False.

parameters.name: AutoFit
parameters.description: True to decrease the width of the table columns as much as possible without changing the way text wraps in the cells. The default value is True.

methods.name: UpdateAutoFormat
methods.description: Updates the table with the characteristics of a predefined table format.

methods.name: Cell
methods.signature: Cell(Row As Long, Column As Long) As Cell
methods.description: Returns a Cell object that represents a cell in a table.

parameters.name: Row
parameters.description: The number of the row in the table to return. Can be an integer between 1 and the number of rows in the table.

parameters.name: Column
parameters.description: The number of the cell in the table to return. Can be an integer between 1 and the number of columns in the table.

methods.name: Split
methods.description: Inserts an empty paragraph immediately above the specified row in the table, and returns a Table object that contains both the specified row and the rows that follow it.

parameters.name: BeforeRow
parameters.description: The row that the table is to be split before. Can be a row number or a Row object.

methods.name: ConvertToText
methods.signature: ConvertToText([Separator As Variant], [NestedTables As Variant]) As Range
methods.description: Converts a table to text and returns a Range object that represents the delimited text.

parameters.name: Separator
parameters.description: The character that delimits the converted columns (paragraph marks delimit the converted rows). Can be any WdTableFieldSeparator constants.

parameters.name: NestedTables
parameters.description: True if nested tables are converted to text. This argument is ignored if Separator is not wdSeparateByParagraphs. The default value is True.

methods.name: AutoFitBehavior
methods.description: Determines how Microsoft Word resizes a table when the AutoFit feature is used.

parameters.name: Behavior
parameters.description: How Word resizes the specified table with the AutoFit feature is used.

methods.name: Sort
methods.signature: Sort([ExcludeHeader As Variant], [FieldNumber As Variant], [SortFieldType As Variant], [SortOrder As Variant], [FieldNumber2 As Variant], [SortFieldType2 As Variant], [SortOrder2 As Variant], [FieldNumber3 As Variant], [SortFieldType3 As Variant], [SortOrder3 As Variant], [CaseSensitive As Variant], [BidiSort As Variant], [IgnoreThe As Variant], [IgnoreKashida As Variant], [IgnoreDiacritics As Variant], [IgnoreHe As Variant], [LanguageID As Variant])

parameters.name: ExcludeHeader
parameters.description: True to exclude the first row from the sort operation. The default value is False.

parameters.name: FieldNumber
parameters.description: The first field by which to sort. Microsoft Word sorts by FieldNumber, then by FieldNumber2, and then by FieldNumber3.

parameters.name: SortFieldType
parameters.description: The sort type for FieldNumber. Can be one of the WdSortFieldType constants. Some of these constants may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed. The default value is wdSortFieldAlphanumeric.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: The sorting order to use when sorting FieldNumber. Can be a WdSortOrder constant.

parameters.name: FieldNumber2
parameters.description: The second field by which to sort.

parameters.name: SortFieldType2
parameters.description: The sort type for FieldNumber2. Can be one of the WdSortFieldType constants. Some of these constants may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed. The default value is wdSortFieldAlphanumeric.

parameters.name: SortOrder2
parameters.description: The sorting order to use when sorting FieldNumber2. Can be one WdSortOrder constant.

parameters.name: FieldNumber3
parameters.description: The third field by which to sort.

parameters.name: SortFieldType3
parameters.description: The sort type for FieldNumber3. Can be one of the WdSortFieldType constants. Some of these constants may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed. The default value is wdSortFieldAlphanumeric.

parameters.name: SortOrder3
parameters.description: The sorting order to use when sorting FieldNumber3. Can be one WdSortOrder constant.

parameters.name: CaseSensitive
parameters.description: True to sort with case sensitivity. The default value is False.

parameters.name: BidiSort
parameters.description: True to sort based on right-to-left language rules. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: IgnoreThe
parameters.description: True to ignore the Arabic character alef lam when sorting right-to-left language text. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: IgnoreKashida
parameters.description: True to ignore kashidas when sorting right-to-left language text. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: IgnoreDiacritics
parameters.description: True to ignore bidirectional control characters when sorting right-to-left language text. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: IgnoreHe
parameters.description: True to ignore the Hebrew character he when sorting right-to-left language text. This argument may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed.

parameters.name: LanguageID
parameters.description: Specifies the sorting language. Can be one of the WdLanguageID constants. Refer to the Object Browser for a list of the WdLanguageID constants.

methods.name: ApplyStyleDirectFormatting
methods.description: Applies the specified style but maintains any formatting that a user directly applies.

parameters.name: StyleName
parameters.description: The name of the style to apply.
